book.name: Mataayo
book.title: Amangʼana Amazomu ga Yeesu Krisito kyeego gakaamirwe na Mataayo

content: Ni weewi wuno akubha omukuru?
Eriibhaga riyo, abhaanabheega bha Yeesu bhakamuuzaku, bhakamubhuurya,
“Ni weewi omukuru kukira abhaandi bhoosi mubhutemi bhwa mwiisaaro?” Yeesu akamubhirikira omwaana omusuuhu, akamwiimeererya gatigati waabhu.
Akabhabhuurira, “Ndabhabhuurira obhuheene, eraabhe mutakwiikyoora no okubha kya abhaana abhasuuhu, mutakusikira kimwe mubhutemi bhwa mwiisaaro.
Kweego, omuutu wowoosi wuno akwiiyiikya no okubha kyeego omwaana omusuuhu wuno, wuyo niwe araabhe omukuru mubhutemi bhwa mwiisaaro.
Kweeki, omuutu wowoosi wuno akumuginihya omwaana omusuuhu kya wuno kwe eriina ryaane, aniginihirye enye.
Obhurekya iguru yo okubhagirya abhaatu kukora amabhiihu

“Nawe eraabhe ariho omuutu wuno araamubhurye owumwe wa abhasuuhu bhano, bhano bhakuniikirirya enye, akagirya akore ebhibhi, yiingabheeri kisi abhoherwe orubhwe mwiigoti no okurekerwa mukiryoonge kye enyaanza.

Muraaza kurora emwe abhaatu bhe ekyaaro kino, kwo okukora amangʼana gano gakugirya abhaatu bhakore ebhibhi! Obhusakya bhutakuturikana okutama kubhaho, nawe araaza kurora omuutu wuno akureeta obhusakya bhuyo!

Eraabhe ni kubhoko kwaazo kasi ni kuguru kwaazo nikwo kukugirya okore ebhibhi, okutine no okukurekera kure. Yiingabheeri kisi kusikira mubhuhoru bhwa kirakeego oribha murema, kukira kubha na amabhoko goosi abhiri kasi amaguru goosi abhiri, nawe okarekerwa mumuriro gwa kirakeego.

Kweeki, eraabhe ni riiso ryaazo niryo rikukugirya okore ebhibhi, oriihe no okurirekera kure! Yiingabheeri kisi kusikira mubhuhoru bhwa kirakeego one kitongʼo, kukira kubha na ameeso goosi abhiri, nawe okarekerwa mumuriro gwa nyaari.”
Ekireengyo kye engʼoondu yino ebhuriri

Yeesu akageenderera kubhabhuurira, “Mwiiriihe, mutarega owumwe wa abhasuuhu bhano! Ndabhabhuurira ego, kwo okubha bhamaraika bhaabhu bha mwiisaaro, eriibhaga ryoosi bharabhurora obhusyo bhwa Taata waane wa mwiisaaro. [
Enye Omwaana wo Omuutu, niiziri mukyaaro okubha nibhatuurye abhaatu bhano bhabhuriri.]

“Muriiseegabhwi? Eraabhe omuutu ane eziingʼoondu igana rimwe (100), ne eyimwe gati waabhu ebhuriri, arakorabhwi? Arazitiga mubhiguru eziingʼoondu miroongo keenda na keenda (99), na aragya kuyikomya yirya ebhuriri? Eheene arakora!
Ndabhabhuurira obhuheene, eraabhe ayibhweeni, arazomererwa bhukongʼu kwe engʼoondu yino eyimwe, kukira eziingʼoondu zirya miroongo keenda na keenda (99) zino zitaabhuriri.
“Kweego ego, Wuuso weenyu wa mwiisaaro, atakweenda kubha naabhe owumwe wa abhasuuhu bhano abhure.
Enzira yo okumurekya omwiikirirya wuno abhuriri
“Eraabhe omwiikirirya omurikyaazo akusariirye, noogye omurekye mukubha bhabhiri ego. Araakwiigwe, ambe orabha omubhweeni kweeki omwiikirirya omurikyaazo.
Nawe kyeego akyaari kukwiigwa, noogye omugege omuutu owuundi kasi abhaatu bhabhiri okubha ‘bhabheho abhamenyeekererya bhabhiri kasi bhatatu bho okumenyeekererya,’
kyeego Amakaamo Amahoreeru gakubhuga.
Ne eraabhe atakubhiigwa bhayo, obhuurire abhaatu bhe ekanisa. Eraabhe atakwiigwa ekanisa, omwaahure kyo omuutu wuno atamumenyiri Taatabhugya kasi omutobhya we eriigooti.

“Ndabhabhuurira obhuheene, gogoosi gano mukugarekya mukyaaro kino, Taatabhugya wuno ari mwiisaaro arabha agarekirye. Kweeki, gogoosi gano mukugiikirirya mukyaaro kino, Taatabhugya wuno ari mwiisaaro arabha agiikiriirye.
Kweeki, ndabhabhuurira obhuheene, eraabhe abhabhiri gati weenyu bhariikirirania mukyaaro kino okusabha eriingʼana ryoryoosi, Taata waane wa mwiisaaro arabhakorera eriingʼana riyo.
Kwo okubha, hohoosi hano bhakubhaho naabhe abhaatu bhabhiri kasi bhatatu bhano bhiikumaniirye kwe eriina ryaane, na neenye ndabhaho hayo hamwe nabho.”
Ekireengyo kyo omuutu wuno atakwaabhira
Niho Petero akaaza ku Yeesu, akamubhuurya, “Ee Omukuru, eraabhe omwiikirirya omurikyaane anisariirye, nireenderwa nimwaabhire kariinge? Nimwaabhire muhuungati koosi?”
Yeesu akamukyoora, “Nikubhuurire, etari muhuungati ego, nawe omwaabhire omurikyaazo muhuungati maanga miroongo muhuungati (70).
“Ndabhabhuurira ego, kwo okubha obhutemi bhwa mwiisaaro bhutuubheeni ne ekireengyo kino. Yaari ariho omutemi wumwe wuno yeendiri okumenya obhubhari bhwe eziimbirya na abhagya bhaaye.
Hano omutemi yataangiri okubhara, akareeterwa omugya wumwe wuno yaari akutunibhwa eziimbirya nzaru bhukongʼu, eziitaraanta
ebhikwe ikumi (10,000).
Omugya wuyo, ataanagirye kuriha esiiri yiyo. Niho omutemi akaswaagya kubha omuutu wuno aguribhwe hamwe na mukaaye, abhaana bhaaye ne ebhigiro bhyoosi bhino yaari nabhyo, okubha arihe esiiri yaaye.
“Ambe, omugya wuyo akamuhigamira omutemi, akamukumiirirya, ‘Ndasabha oniigumiirire, ndakuriha esiiri yaazo yoosi!’
Niho, omutemi akamurorera ebhigoongi omugya waaye, akamwaabhira esiiri yaaye yoosi, akamuhaatira agye owaaye.
“Hano omugya wuyo yarwiiri igutu, akamubhona omugya omurikyaaye wuno yaari aramutunia eziimbirya suuhu bhukongʼu, ekireengo kye eziidinaari
igana rimwe ego (100). Hayohayo, akamumamira mwiimiro, akamubhuurira, ‘Nirihe esiiri yaane!’
“Omugya omurikyaaye akamuhigamira, akamukumiirirya, ‘Ndasabha oniigumiirire, ndakuriha esiiri yaazo!’
Nawe akaanga, akagya okumubhoha omurikyaaye munyuumba ya abhabhohwa, tee eriibhaga rino araarihe esiiri yaaye.
“Hano abhagya abharikyaaye bhaaruuzi engʼana yiyo, bhakarumirirwa bhukongʼu muziikoro zyaabhu. Niho bhakagya kumutemi waabhu no kumubhuurira goosi gano gaakorekiri.
Niho omutemi akamubhirikira omugya wuno yamwaabhiiri esiiri yaaye, akamubhuurira, ‘Awe ni mugya omubhiihu bhukongʼu! Rora, hano wanisabhiri kubha nikwaabhire esiiri yaazo, nakwaabhiiri yoosi!
Mbe, na woosi otakweenderwa kumurorera ebhigoongi omugya omurikyaazo, kyeego enye nakuroreeri awe ebhigoongi?’
Ambe, omutemi akabhiihirirwa bhukongʼu, akaragania abhasirikare bhaaye, bhamugwaate no okumutuura munyuumba ya abhabhohwa bhabhe bharamunyaakya, tee hano araarihe esiiri yoosi.”

Kyaamwe, Yeesu akamariirya kwo okugaamba, “Mumenye kubha naabhe Taata waane wa mwiisaaro, arabhakorera na neemwe egoego, eraabhe muraanga kumwaabhira omwiikirirya omurikyeenyu kwe eziikoro zyeenyu zyoosi.”

footnotes.text: Muhuungati maanga miroongo muhuungati, obhugazuro bhwaku ni mwaabhire eriibhaga ryoosi.
Eziitaraanta ni mbirya zye ekare. Etaraanta yimwe yaari ya amariho ge emyaaka miroongo ebhiri (20).
Eziidinaari ni mbirya zye ekare. Edinaari yimwe yaari ya amariho go orusiku rumwe rwe emirimo.
